test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

**Question:**

**How is Damini related to Bhola?**

**Statements:**

I. Tika has only one son, Bhola and only one daughter, Kamala.

II. Damini is Roma's son's wife. Kamala is the only daughter of Roma. Meghna is the daughter of Bhola.

options.text: Statement II alone is sufficient, while Statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient, while Statement II alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
Both Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
Statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.

solution:
Statements:

I. Tika has only one son, Bhola and only one daughter, Kamala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d7e632dd2fc0d486987a04946c1381136c7ad531bf9d4463e99c8080b21bcfe.png] 

II. Damini is Roma's son's wife. Kamala is the only daughter of Roma. Meghan is the daughter of Bhola.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f108c2967eb7481403545319fb3b0c04a5269511c45dd62c8f6ffe652d704a.png] 

**When combining Statement I and II:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33715e19649522f259b34e0c4bbd6ac36d9a05f0330672d42d169c092747914a.png] 

Thus, Damini is the wife of Bhola.

Hence, **"Both Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question."**
